# laya-ts (vendored)

The TypeScript runtime of [Laya](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya) by Convai Innovations,
Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). laya-ts isn't published to npm, so Kestrel keeps a copy here.

- Source: `laya-ts/src` at commit `6f0496f797dc7127265d62e1543a62de507d943c`.
- Unchanged except where marked `// Kestrel:` in the code.
- Kestrel runs it in the Kestrel Sort utility process (`src/sort/`), on `onnxruntime-node`.
